author: gobernment
body:
That was probably my favorite lobby. It was the perfect size, easy to navigate, easy to decorate, and overall a lot more fun with the most secrets and areas. It contained the sandbox, a ton of minigames, a pvp area, and the parkour. It probably is the lobby with the most content and I believe that the current lobby is too large and laggy, what with all of the non-full blocks (fences, walls, etc.) and not as fun/easy to navigate. There's a lot of unused space and there's not as much stuff to do as there was before.

Sandbox TNT
